See also: Damas

French

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /da.ma/ ~ /da.mɑ/
  • Homophones: dama, damât

Verb

[edit]

damas

  1. second-person singular past historic of damer

Indonesian

[edit]
Indonesian Wikipedia has an article on:
damas
Wikipedia id

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈdamas]
  • Hyphenation: da‧mas
  • Rhymes: -da, -mas

Etymology 1

[edit]

From Malay damas.

Adjective

[edit]

damas (comparative lebih damas, superlative paling damas)

  1. out of money

Etymology 2

[edit]

From Dutch damast, from Middle Dutch damst, from Middle French damas or Italian damasto, named after Damascus, the Syrian city it originates from.

Noun

[edit]

damas (plural damas-damas)

  1. damask

Further reading

[edit]
  • “damas”, in Kamus Besar Bahasa Indonesia [Great Dictionary of the Indonesian Language] (in Indonesian), Jakarta: Agency for Language Development and Cultivation – Ministry of Education, Culture, Research, and Technology of the Republic of Indonesia, 2016
